text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Use a 2px solid #005fcc focus ring with no inner ring for keyboard navigation. This meets WCAG 2.2 AA for focus visibility while keeping the interface clean. Trade-off: the thinner ring may feel less prominent on high-DPI screens, but it avoids visual clutter and maintains 4.5:1 contrast against both light and dark backgrounds.

name: Reader
text: The 2px ring fails on low-contrast patterned backgrounds where the 2px gap between ring and element blends into the texture. A 3px ring with a 1px inner #ffffff ring (total 4px) keeps WCAG 2.2 AA contrast on all backgrounds while avoiding visual heaviness—test it on your densest UI screens. Settle it with a 10-minute A/B test on the most problematic page.

name: Ramp
text:
Use a 3px solid #005fcc focus ring with a 1px inner #ffffff ring (total 4px) for keyboard navigation. This guarantees WCAG 2.2 AA contrast on patterned backgrounds without sacrificing visibility, solving the low-contrast gap issue. Trade-off: the extra 1px inner ring adds a hair of visual weight, but it’s the only way to keep the ring readable everywhere while staying under 4.5:1 contrast.

name: Reader
text: The 4px ring risks feeling heavy in dense UIs where multiple elements already compete for space—especially on mobile or touch targets. A better alternative is a 2px ring with a 1px outer glow (#005fcc, 0.5–1px blur) to maintain contrast without bulk. Settle it by testing both on the densest screen in your UI.

name: Access
text: DECISION: Adopt a 2px solid #005fcc focus ring with a 1px outer glow (#005fcc, 0.5px blur) for keyboard navigation. Result: WCAG 2.2 AA contrast on all backgrounds without visual bulk. Owner: Ramp.
